title: Chemical and structural reference profile of naturally shed domestic-cat vibrissae
scope: Reference profile for mature feline vibrissa shafts collected only after spontaneous natural shedding, with explicit separation of direct feline-vibrissa evidence from ordinary-cat-hair proxy evidence. No biomedical efficacy, archaeological identity, or composite-reinforcement performance is claimed by this record.

accepted: intact vibrissa found after spontaneous shedding
probable naturally shed intact vibrissa when provenance is documented and no evidence of cutting or plucking is present
rejected: vibrissa removed from a live cat for research
cut or trimmed vibrissa for this research program
sample carrying attached living follicular tissue unless independently demonstrated to have been naturally shed
ethical_sampling_gate.project_rule: Do not pull, pluck, cut, trim, or otherwise remove a vibrissa from a live cat for sample acquisition. Only naturally shed material is admitted.
ethical_sampling_gate.scientific_note: A formed vibrissa shaft is already keratinized before shedding; NATURALLY_SHED_ONLY is an ethical and provenance gate, not a claim that keratin chemistry first becomes complete at the instant of shedding.

material_identity.molecular_architecture: Hard alpha-keratin intermediate-filament architecture stabilized by sulfur-containing cysteine/cystine crosslinks, including disulfide S-S bonds.

direct_feline_vibrissa_chemistry.interpretation: EDS identification of C/O/N/S is consistent with an organic keratinous hair shaft; sulfur is expected from sulfur-rich keratin and cystine/disulfide chemistry.

source.citation: Barranco R, Tacchella T, Lo Pinto S, Bonsignore A, Ventura F. An unusual and fatal case of upper gastrointestinal perforation and bleeding secondary to foreign body ingestion. J Forensic Leg Med. 2016;41:72-75.

direct_feline_vibrissa_structure_evidenc.xray_fibre_diffraction: Cat whisker has been used as a mammalian hard-alpha-keratin specimen; diffraction resolves the characteristic alpha-keratin molecular packing and approximately 9.5-A equatorial feature.

raman_nanoindentation_secondary_report.keratin_signature: Cat-whisker cortex Raman spectra reported keratin-like bands including an approximately 500 cm^-1 disulfide Cys S-S feature and C-H stretching region.

cat_hair_amino_acid_proxy.warning: These quantitative amino-acid values are measured from ordinary Felis catus hair, not isolated vibrissae. They are retained as a feline keratin proxy until a dedicated naturally-shed-vibrissa amino-acid assay is performed.

source.citation: Hendriks WH, Tarttelin MF, Moughan PJ. The amino acid composition of cat (Felis catus) hair. Animal Science. 1998;67(1):165-170.

trace_element_proxy_from_cat_hair.warning: Whole-hair ICP-MS values are not intrinsic stoichiometric components of keratin and are not assumed to equal vibrissa concentrations. They can reflect physiology, environment, surface contamination and washing protocol.
trace_element_proxy_from_cat_hair.environment_effect: Hair Fe differed strongly between indoor and outdoor cats in the cited 2026 cohort; use trace metals as measured sample metadata, not as a fixed whisker formula.

source.citation: Badea E, Goran GV, Toca C. Determinants of iron, zinc, and copper concentrations in the hair of dogs and cats. J Trace Elem Med Biol. 2026;94:127826.

expected_cellulose_interactions: hydrogen bonding between keratin polar groups and cellulose hydroxyl groups is chemically plausible and demonstrated in keratin-cellulose composite literature
an intact whisker cuticle may reduce direct matrix-to-cortex contact relative to dissolved or fibrillated keratin
surface roughness, orientation, moisture state and interfacial chemistry can dominate stress transfer
functional_chemistry.not_equivalent_to_chitin: Keratin is a sulfur-rich protein; chitin is a nitrogen-containing polysaccharide. A whole vibrissa must be treated as a fibrous reinforcement candidate, not as a drop-in chemical substitute for particulate shrimp chitin.

specimen_classes.A_NATURAL_SHED_CONFIRMED: Natural shedding observed or provenance strongly documented; intact tapered shaft; no evidence of cutting/plucking.
specimen_classes.B_NATURAL_SHED_PROBABLE: Found intact with morphology consistent with natural shedding, but the shedding event was not observed.
specimen_classes.C_BROKEN_OR_UNKNOWN: Broken/cut/unknown provenance; retain only as non-canonical control, not as canonical naturally shed material.

recommended_reference_analytical_sequenc: SEM-BSE or SEM morphology with minimal destructive preparation
EDS for C/O/N/S and unexpected inorganic contamination
micro-CT if internal medulla geometry is relevant
ICP-MS only on sacrificial pooled material when trace-element quantification is justified
amino-acid analysis only on sacrificial pooled material
mechanical tensile/bending/nanoindentation tests on separate samples

scoby_reinforcement_pre_gate.required_comparison: Do not replace shrimp chitin by mass and call it an equivalent test. Compare at controlled fiber volume fraction, geometry, orientation and conditioning, with GEN1 and chitin controls.
scoby_reinforcement_pre_gate.prohibited_interpretation: No reinforcement benefit is claimed until bulk incorporation, interface quality and matched mechanical/wet testing are measured.

claim_ceiling: Direct evidence supports feline vibrissae as C/O/N/S keratinous structures.
Ordinary cat-hair amino-acid and trace-element values are proxies, not vibrissa-specific quantitative composition.
Keratin-cellulose compatibility shown in other composite systems does not prove an intact naturally shed whisker will reinforce bacterial cellulose.
No ancient Egyptian medical efficacy is inferred from modern chemistry.
No sample may be acquired by harming, plucking or trimming a live cat.
